concept.headline: The SomnoBalance idea
concept.body:
Regeneration doesn't only begin when we sleep. Even during the day, tension, thoughts and habits influence how easily we find calm.

SomnoBalance brings together targeted impulses for self-regulation, mindful rituals and a sleep environment that supports regeneration into one holistic concept that accompanies you from the active day into the night.
concept.statement: The day shapes the night. The night, the day that follows.

circuit.headline: The SomnoBalance Regeneration Cycle
circuit.intro: Four phases that interlock: Regulate, Let Go, Prepare and Regenerate. SomnoBalance accompanies you with mindful regeneration impulses, soothing rituals and a supportive sleep environment – from the active day into the night.
circuit.closing: And in the morning, the cycle begins again.

phases.headline: How to accompany the four phases through your day.
phases.intro: No two days are the same. The four SomnoBalance phases give you orientation without prescribing a fixed sequence. Choose the small steps that fit your situation.

items.name: Regulate
items.title: A pause in the middle of the day
items.body: Between appointments, tasks and conversations there is often little time to pause. Draw a regeneration card, read the impulse it describes and take a short moment to try it out in peace.

items.name: Let Go
items.title: Leaving the working day behind
items.body: Before the evening begins, create a conscious transition: put the phone aside, sit down for a moment and – if you like and tolerate scents – choose your personal scent as a ritual.

items.name: Prepare
items.title: A recurring evening ritual
items.body: Give the evening a recognisable structure. For example, prepare a cup of regeneration tea, reduce distractions and arrange the bedroom so that you feel comfortable in it.

items.name: Regenerate
items.title: Choosing the sleep environment consciously
items.body: When you lie down to rest, the environment matters too: a pillow that suits how you lie, a suitable mattress and a pleasant sense of space. This way you extend your day and evening rituals into the night.

routine.eyebrow: SMALL RITUALS THAT FIT INTO EVERYDAY LIFE

stations.label: During the day

stations.label: In the evening

stations.label: At night
stations.body: Look for a pillow, a mattress and a sense of space that fit your personal needs.

hero.headline: Regeneration is not a single moment. It is an interplay.
hero.p1: Regeneration doesn't begin in bed. What we experience during the day, how we deal with tension and which transitions we allow ourselves can influence how we find calm in the evening.
hero.p2: SomnoBalance brings together impulses for self-regulation, mindful rituals and a sleep environment that supports regeneration. The result is a holistic path that accompanies people from the active day into the night – and begins again the next morning.
hero.leitsatz: The day shapes the night. The night, the day that follows.

story.headline: Two experiences became one shared idea.
paragraphs: The idea for SomnoBalance grew out of the daily work in Nicole Willing's kinesiology practice. Again and again she met people who, besides personal and health challenges, also spoke of inner restlessness, tension and difficult nights. It became clear: anyone who wants to support regeneration shouldn't start only at bedtime.

Nicole therefore looked more closely at everyday ways of self-regulation. From this she developed her own collection of regeneration impulses and selected acupressure points, meant to help people create mindful pauses and pay closer attention to their body's signals again.

At the same time, Friedrich Alexander Willing contributed his more than 35 years of experience with beds, mattresses and high-quality sleep systems. His focus is on the environment in which we spend the night: lying comfort, individual needs and the quality of the sleep environment.

SomnoBalance emerged from both perspectives: a concept that doesn't separate the day from the night but connects the two. It is not a single product that takes centre stage, but the interplay of self-regulation, rituals and sleep environment.

people.headline: Two perspectives. One shared idea.

profiles.name: Nicole Willing
profiles.body: Nicole Willing is a kinesiologist and the developer of the SomnoBalance method. She has been supporting people in her practice for around ten years. From her experience of how closely tension, inner calm and regeneration are linked in everyday life, she developed practical regeneration impulses that can be consciously integrated into the day. Her aim is to encourage people toward greater self-awareness and self-regulation – without complicated routines or unrealistic promises.

profiles.name: Friedrich Alexander Willing
profiles.body: Friedrich Alexander Willing has worked with beds, mattresses and individual sleep systems for more than 35 years. His experience shows how important a sleep environment tailored to personal needs is. At SomnoBalance he complements the impulses for the day with the perspective of the night – from high-quality lying comfort to the conscious design of the bedroom.

people.closing: What connects us is the conviction that lasting regeneration doesn't begin at a single point. It emerges when we look at the person and their everyday life as a whole.

phases.headline: Four phases that interlock.
phases.intro: SomnoBalance follows a simple idea: the day prepares the night, and the night creates the foundation for a new day. The four phases offer orientation – not as a rigid programme, but as an invitation to shape your own rhythm more consciously.

items.name: Regulate
items.title: Consciously arriving in the day
items.body: Small regeneration impulses and selected points invite you to pause in everyday life, notice your own state and consciously support self-regulation.

items.name: Let Go
items.title: Shaping transitions
items.body: Between tasks, thoughts and obligations, a moment of distance is sometimes needed. Simple rituals can help you avoid carrying the day unchecked into the evening.

items.name: Prepare
items.title: Giving calm room
items.body: Mindful evening habits, pleasant scents and a quiet environment accompany the transition into the night. What matters is not perfection but a routine that fits your own life.

items.name: Regenerate
items.title: Supporting the night
items.body: An individually tailored sleep environment with suitable pillows, mattresses and sleep systems creates good conditions for restful nights. In the morning, the cycle begins again.

blocks.headline: Not the single product. The interplay.
blocks.p1: Regeneration cards offer suggestions for small, mindful moments during the day. Scents, roll-on, oil blend, room spray and tea can accompany personal rituals. The 21-day guide helps turn individual impulses into a recurring practice. Pillows, mattresses and regeneration beds complete the concept where the night begins.
blocks.p2: Every building block can stand on its own. It gains its particular meaning, however, in the context of your personal regeneration path. SomnoBalance doesn't want to prescribe a fixed routine, but to offer orientation and support people in finding their own rhythm.

cta.headline: Discover your personal regeneration path.
cta.body: Whether you want to pause more consciously during the day, shape the evening more calmly or take a fresh look at your sleep environment: begin where it suits you right now.

method.headline: Developed in practice. For new paths to regeneration.
method.p1: The SomnoBalance Method was developed by Nicole Willing from her many years of work as a kinesiologist.
method.p2: In her practice she repeatedly meets people who, alongside physical or emotional strain, also report ongoing stress, inner restlessness and sleep problems.
method.p3: These observations led to a closer look at the connections between tension, relaxation and regeneration.
method.listIntro: The result is an independent, body-oriented application that combines several elements:
elements: Selected elements of energetic jaw-joint relaxation according to Philip Rafferty
method.p4: The individual elements follow a defined sequence and together form the SomnoBalance Method.
method.p5: The focus is on conscious body awareness, releasing tension and the opportunity to experience relaxation and calm.
method.practice: Nicole Willing offers the SomnoBalance Method in her kinesiology practice in Lemgo. There, interested people can learn more about how the method came about and how it is applied.

training.title: The SomnoBalance Method in your facility too
training.p1: For wellness hotels, spa areas and health practices, the SomnoBalance Method is an interesting way to extend an existing offering with a distinctive treatment.
training.p2: In a practice-oriented training, Nicole Willing teaches the method and its practical application. Her aim is to make SomnoBalance available in more facilities.

training.invite: We look forward to your enquiry and will gladly tell you about the possibilities of working together.
